78944458.title: Abbie Stockard
78944458.extract: Abbie Stockard (born July 26, 2002) is an American beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss America 2025. Stockard was previously crowned Miss Alabama 2024, making her the fourth woman from Alabama to be crowned Miss America.

58497647.title: Anastasia Schipanova
58497647.extract: Anastasia Schipanova is a Russian contemporary artist, model, actress, fashion designer, and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss Earth Belarus. She represented Belarus at Miss Earth 2018 in Manila, Philippines.

78605541.title: Angélique Angarni-Filopon
78605541.extract: Angélique Cindy Marie Denise Angarni-Filopon (born 9 October 1990) is a French beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss France 2025. She had previously won Miss Martinique 2024 and is the first woman from Martinique to win Miss France.

77998258.title: CJ Opiaza
77998258.extract: Christine Juliane Hinkle Opiaza (born July 8, 1998) is a Filipina model and beauty pageant titleholder crowned Miss Grand International 2024 after assuming the title. She is the first Filipina to hold the Miss Grand International title.

78353952.title: Catalina Duque
78353952.extract: Catalina Duque Abréu (born September 29, 1999) is a Colombian beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss International 2025. She previously won Miss Colombia 2024 and is the fourth Colombian woman to win the Miss International title.

82725220.title: Elle Chapman
82725220.extract: Elle Chapman is an American actress, best known for her role as Paige McIntosh in The Madison (2026).

79006169.title: Emilia Dides
79006169.extract: Emilia Ignacia Dides Maffei (born June 29, 1999), also known by her stage name Emi D, is a Chilean singer, model and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss Universe Chile 2024. She represented Chile at the Miss Universe 2024 pageant, where she placed in the Top 12 semifinalists and won the People's Choice Award, marking Chile's strongest showing in the competition in over three decades.

78394426.title: Geyssell García
78394426.extract: Geyssell García is a Nicaraguan beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss Universe Nicaragua 2024. She represented Nicaragua at Miss Universe 2024, against 125 contestants, and reached the top 30.

79868950.title: Kara Leona
79868950.extract: Kara Leona Bass (born May 11, 1992) is an American singer, model, and social media personality. She became known for appearing in the TLC reality television franchise, 90 Day Fiancé.

78060019.title: Karnruethai Tassabut
78060019.extract: Karnruethai Tassabut is a Thai beauty pageant titleholder, model and flight attendant. She is the first Thai woman to win the title of Runner-up at Miss Cosmo 2024, and she also won second runner-up at Miss Universe Thailand 2024.

63801548.title: Kyra Santoro
63801548.extract: Kyra Savannah Santoro (born March 22, 1993) is an actress, model, author and singer. She was born in Los Angeles, California.

77914172.title: Lia Elalouf
77914172.extract: Lia Elalouf is an Israeli model and actress. She won the Ophir Award for Best Leading Actress in 2024 for her role in the film Come Closer.

60013727.title: Moe Hay Ko
60013727.extract: Moe Hay Ko (born Aye Aye Khine on 26 June 1985) is a Burmese actress, model, producer and businesswoman. She is the Myanmar's third highest-paid actress and considered one of the most commercially successful actresses in Burmese cinema.

59084231.title: Nan Su Yati Soe
59084231.extract: Nan Su Yati Soe (also spelt Nansu Yati Soe, born 18 September 1987) is a Burmese actress, model, singer and TV host who has achieved fame and success as an actress and singer. Throughout her successful career, she has acted in over 200 films and released two solo albums.

82098455.title: Polli Cannabis
82098455.extract: Polli Cannabis (born 6 September 1997) is a Belarusian model, actress and TV host. She is known for winning the Lady Universe and Miss Elite Europe in 2021.

77937163.title: Rhea Singha
77937163.extract: Rhea Singha (born 10 December 2004) is an Indian model, actress and beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss Universe India 2024 on 22 September 2024, in Jaipur, India. Singha represented India at the Miss Universe 2024 pageant held on 16 November 2024, in Mexico and ended up as a Top 30 semi-finalist.

80432815.title: Valentina Alekseeva
80432815.extract: Valentina Andreevna Alekseeva (born 11 August 2006) is a Russian model and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss Russia 2024. As Miss Russia, Alekseeva represented Russia at Miss Universe 2024, where she placed in the top 12.

78378148.title: Victoria Kjær Theilvig
78378148.extract: Victoria Kjær Theilvig (born 13 November 2003) is a Danish beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss Universe 2024. Theilvig is the first Dane to win the title, and also the first woman with blonde hair to win the title in more than 20 years.

78430734.title: Zhao Qing (actress)
78430734.extract: Zhao Qing (Chinese: 赵晴, born August 4, 2000), is a Chinese actress under Huanyu Entertainment. She is best known for her role as Mu Yao in Scent of Time (2023).

72619872.title: Big Brother Titans
72619872.extract: Big Brother Titans is the joint South African and Nigerian edition of the Big Brother franchise. The theme for the first season was "Ziyakhala Wahala".
